faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions. If anything's missing, reach out to support.
faq.q_pricing: How much does SIGMACODE AI cost?
faq.a_pricing: Flexible pricing for teams and enterprises: usage‑based or fixed enterprise plans with SLAs. Talk to sales for a custom quote.
faq.q_trial: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.a_trial: Yes. Start free to evaluate core features, models and integrations. Upgrade anytime without data loss.
faq.a_security: Encryption at rest/in transit, RBAC, audit logs, data minimization. GDPR support and EU‑only processing on request.
faq.q_deployment: Can I deploy in my cloud/VPC or on‑prem?
faq.a_deployment: Yes: managed cloud or self‑hosting in your VPC/on‑prem. Hybrid setups with private networking and your own KMS are supported.
faq.a_integrations: Native connectors (GitHub, Slack, Notion, Jira), webhooks, REST/GraphQL API. SDKs for TypeScript & Python.
faq.q_customization: Can I customize or fine‑tune models?
faq.a_customization: Yes. Domain knowledge, retrieval, guardrails, fine‑tuning (tone, structure, compliance). Versioning & A/B tests included.
faq.a_accuracy: Evaluation suites, benchmarks and human‑in‑the‑loop. Track precision/recall, latency & cost per task in the dashboard.
faq.q_compliance: Which compliance standards do you support?
faq.a_compliance: GDPR by design; processes aligned with SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Data residency & DPA available for enterprise.
faq.q_models: Which models and languages are supported?
faq.a_models: Leading foundation models and multilingual use cases. Bring‑your‑own‑model, switch providers without code rewrite.
faq.q_sla: What support options and SLAs are available?
faq.a_sla: From community support to dedicated success managers and 99.9% uptime SLAs. Prioritized incident response in enterprise.
faq.q_cancellation: Can I cancel anytime? Who owns my data?
faq.a_cancellation: Yes. You retain full ownership; export projects securely before closing your account.
faq.a_mas: MAS stands for Multi‑Agent Systems: multiple specialized agents work together (delegation, handoffs, parallelism) to complete complex tasks end‑to‑end – with governance (approvals, checkpoints) and auditability.
faq.q_agents_vs_mas: What's the difference between an agent and MAS?
faq.a_agents_vs_mas: A single agent handles a well‑defined task. MAS orchestrates several specialized agents as a team – for larger initiatives with aligned roles, escalation paths and quality controls.
faq.a_billing: Choose usage‑based (tokens/interpreter credits) or plan‑based (seats, limits). Enterprise: fixed SLAs, custom quotas and contract options.
faq.a_limits: Yes, fair‑use via rate limits, credits and plan quotas. In enterprise, limits can be adjusted or lifted.
faq.q_data_residency: Where is my data stored? (Data residency)
faq.a_data_residency: EU/region hosting available. Alternatively, self‑host in your own VPC/on‑prem with full data control.
faq.q_api_sdk: Do you provide an API & SDK?
faq.a_api_sdk: Yes. Clean REST/GraphQL API, webhooks and SDKs for TypeScript & Python for fast integration.
faq.q_onboarding: What's the best way to get started?
faq.a_onboarding: Create an account, connect data sources, pick a template (e.g., support bot, content pipeline), test an agent and deploy. Our guide walks you through step by step.
